name: Companion.energy
description:
Companion.energy Analytics is a read-only remote MCP server that lets AI assistants query live energy analytics from the Companion.energy platform in natural language — no dashboards or manual exports.

Companion.energy is an energy-optimization platform for commercial and industrial sites. This connector gives your assistant secure, read-only access to your organization's data across:

• Assets & locations — batteries, solar, grid connections, EV chargers and more
• Sensor time series — consumption, production, power, state of charge and temperature, both raw and aggregated
• Cost, revenue & savings — energy cost breakdowns, revenue, and realised savings
• Market data — day-ahead spot prices, imbalance prices and metrics, and futures curves across European markets
• Steering & flexibility — capacity under active energy-steering control
• Forecasts, energy balance, profiles, spot exposure, imbalance, hedge positions and peak consumption

Ask questions like "Show hourly consumption for the Antwerp plant last week and highlight the peak," "Break down energy cost by site for Q2," or "What were yesterday's Belgian day-ahead prices, and when was the cheapest hour?" The assistant retrieves the answer live and can also run its own read-only queries against the full analytics schema for anything the curated tools don't cover.

Built for safety and governance:
• Strictly read-only — 16 tools, every one annotated read-only; the server rejects any write, mutation or subscription
• OAuth 2.1 sign-in — you authenticate to Companion.energy in the browser on first connect
• Organization-scoped access — you only ever see data you're entitled to, enforced per request
• Least-privilege scopes and per-organization rate limits
• Your data is used only to answer your request, never to train models

Requires a Companion.energy account. Learn more and connect at companion.energy.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Companion.energy to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Companion.energy to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.companion.energy/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Companion.energy MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Companion.energy lists 16 MCP tools, including get_asset, get_futures, get_graphql_schema, get_imbalance_dual_pricing_stats, get_market_price_series, get_market_price_stats, get_market_prices, get_preferred_sensor, get_sensor_readings, get_sensor_series, get_steered_capacity, and list_assets.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Companion.energy?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Companion.energy in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
Companion.energy requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Companion.energy is developed by Companion.energy. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
